# Fact: Operating System

## Statement

Alex uses macOS as the primary operating system.

## Context

Alex runs macOS on an Apple MacBook Pro for daily development work.
The Mac is configured with Homebrew for package management and uses zsh as the default shell.
Occasionally a Linux VM is used for server-side testing.
